title: Lucia & Bex

redChapters.caseName: What Is the Maid of Honor Hiding Ten Days Before the Wedding?

description: Lucia is getting married in ten days, and her maid of honor has started calling the groom at midnight. She has one morning with Bex's phone and a head full of the worst possible explanation. What the phone actually holds is a county record, a returned payment and a name she has never heard.

questions.question:
Okay. I'm doing this. My hands are shaking 😔
Bex was at my place last night helping me fold place cards. She left early, said she was wiped.
She's never wiped. She closes down every party we've ever been to.
Who did she call after she left?
questions.revealGuide:
Open Phone and go to Recents.
Find last night's calls: one outgoing call at 9:47 PM, 14 minutes long.
Why: The only call she made after leaving Lucia's was to Colm Teague.

questions.question:
Him?? That's my fiancé 😳
Three nights ago he told me he was working late. That same night Bex bailed on wine with me, some excuse about work.
I don't want to think what I'm thinking.
Where exactly did the two of them meet that night?
questions.revealGuide:
Open Calendar and go back three days.
Skip the afternoon work block, 'Depo prep — conf room B'; it ended at 4:00 PM.
Open the 7:30 PM event titled 'C. — Copper Finch'.
Why: She met Colm at Copper Finch, a cocktail bar on Alder Street.

questions.question:
That's a cocktail bar. Dim lights, tiny tables. He's never once taken me there.
And it gets worse. Colm says one of our vendors put our order on hold, and he won't tell me which one. I didn't do it.
Which vendor did she contact behind my back?
questions.hint: Look through her Mail, including what she sent.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Mail, open the menu and go to Sent.
Skip the vendor emails that have Lucia cc'd.
Open the one without her on it, 'Ferrante–Teague, August 16 — please hold the final balance'.
Why: It went to Juniper & Rye Catering, and Lucia was never copied.

questions.question:
Of course it's the biggest bill of the whole wedding 😤
I don't get it. Bex is broke right now. She's been skipping lunches to save money, I've watched her do it.
I need to know where her money is actually going.
Who got her biggest single payment over the past 30 days?
questions.revealGuide:
Open RevoBank and open Current Account.
Scroll through the past 30 days of payments and compare the amounts, not how often a name repeats.
The $118.00 to Haywood Animal Clinic is close, but the largest single payment is $142.00.
Why: It went to Dunmore County Clerk, a name that appears only once.

questions.question:
I had to look that up. It's a courthouse office three states away.
Bex has lived in Asheville her whole adult life. No family out there, no cases out there, no reason at all to call them.
What was she looking for there?
answer: certified copy of a marriage record
questions.revealGuide:
Open Safari and open History.
Scroll back about three weeks to the searches that mention Dunmore County.
Read what she typed: 'Dunmore County Oklahoma marriage records'.
Why: She was searching for marriage records and ordering a certified copy.

questions.question:
Why would she want those?
Wait. Colm lived out there for years before we met. He never talks about it, just calls it a boring chapter.
My stomach just dropped 😳
Whose name did she find next to his?
questions.revealGuide:
Open Photos and scroll back about two weeks.
Open the photo of an official paper with a gold seal, 'Certified Copy of Marriage Certificate'.
Read the two large printed names in the middle.
Why: The certificate joins Colm A. Teague and Shauna M. Lindqvist.

questions.question:
I have never heard that name in my life 💔
He told me there was nobody serious before me. Nobody. I asked him straight out on our third date.
Maybe it ended years ago and he was just embarrassed.
What did the clerk's office find when it came to a divorce?
questions.hint: Go back to her Mail inbox.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Mail and find the emails from Dunmore County Clerk.
Skip the payment confirmation and open the later reply, 'Re: Records request — Teague'.
Read the line under the divorce and dissolution search.
Why: The clerk wrote 'Result: No record found.' No divorce was ever filed there.

questions.question:
So on paper he's still her husband. And in ten days he was going to be mine.
I keep telling myself there's an explanation. People lose touch. People disappear.
But she has to be out there somewhere.
Where does she live now?
questions.revealGuide:
Open WhatsApp and open the chat with her sister, Imogen.
Scroll up about two weeks to where Bex tells her she found Shauna.
Why: Bex wrote that Shauna 'lives in Tulsa now'.

questions.question:
That's far, but it's not the moon.
Bex is a paralegal. She never takes anyone's word for anything. She'd track this woman down and ask for proof.
I'd want proof too 😔
What did the woman give her to prove it?
questions.revealGuide:
Open WhatsApp and open the chat with 'Shauna L.'.
Scroll to the image she sent after 'You want proof? Here.'
The bride has the same face and blonde braid as Shauna's profile picture; the groom is a younger Colm in a suit.
Why: Shauna sent their wedding photo.

questions.question:
I think I'm going to be sick 💔
So Bex took this to him. That's what the late calls and the secret meetings were. Not an affair.
Colm thinks every problem has a price tag.
How much did he offer her to stay quiet?
questions.hint: Check her Messages, older parts of a long thread.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Messages and open the thread with Colm Teague.
Scroll up about nine days, past the newest messages, to a late-night text.
Read: 'Name a number. I'll send you $5,000 tonight and this stays between us until after the wedding.'
Why: Colm offered her $5,000 to keep quiet.

questions.question:
That's more than her car is worth 🥲
And she needs it. She's two payments behind on that car, she told me so herself.
Honestly, I wouldn't even blame her.
If he sent it, what did she do with the money?
questions.revealGuide:
Open PayPal and scroll the activity list to about nine days ago.
Find the $5,000.00 payment received from Colm Teague and open it.
Read its status.
Why: The payment is marked Refunded. She sent every dollar back the next morning.

questions.question:
Of course she did. That's Bex ❤️
But hold on. He told me we were stretched thin. Colm handles our wedding fund, I only ever hear the total from him.
He shouldn't have that kind of cash lying around.
How much is missing from our wedding fund?
questions.revealGuide:
Open Drive and ignore the shared 'Wedding Budget' file.
Open 'Wedding Budget — Bex reconcile copy'.
Scroll to the bottom line labeled 'Unaccounted'.
Why: Her reconciliation shows $18,400 unaccounted for.

questions.question:
That's most of two years of my shop's savings 😔
Every early market run, every wedding I did flowers for while planning my own. I handed it all to him.
What has he been paying for with it?
questions.revealGuide:
Open Mail and find the starred email from Colm Teague, 'Fwd: Your account statement'.
Scroll through the statement lines he forwarded by mistake.
The same $1,150.00 line repeats every month: 'CHILD SUPPORT PMT — OK CSS'.
Why: He has been paying child support out of the wedding fund.

questions.question:
He has a child.
He has a child and I've been picking out centerpieces 💔
A whole little person he never once mentioned, not in three years.
What's the child's name?
questions.revealGuide:
Open Messages and open the thread with Colm Teague.
Find the exchange from four days ago that starts with Bex writing 'I met your son.'
Read Colm's reply.
Why: He answers, 'You had no right to go near Declan.'

questions.question:
That's a sweet name. None of this is that kid's fault.
I need to go back to something. A week ago Bex said she had a work trip and went quiet for a while. She barely answered me.
Where did she stay?
questions.hint: Check Settings, then the Wi-Fi networks.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Settings and tap Wi-Fi.
Read the list of known networks and their 'Last joined' labels.
Find the one that says 'Last joined 6 days ago': 'Cedar Bluff Inn Guest'.
Why: Her phone was on the guest Wi-Fi at Cedar Bluff Inn during the trip.

questions.question:
She went all that way for me and never said a word 🥲
Bex works for injury lawyers, car wrecks and insurance. She'd never make a move like this without asking someone who really knows.
What kind of lawyer has she been talking to?
questions.hint: Check her Phone: recent calls, then contacts.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Phone and look at Recents from the past week.
Notice the repeated calls with 'P. Meyers', all after office hours.
Open that contact and read the note.
Why: The note says 'Paula Meyers — family law attorney'.

questions.question:
So she was finding out what this means for me. Legally.
Here's what I can't get past. We filled out our marriage license application together. I sat right beside him and watched him write.
What did he put down about previous marriages?
questions.revealGuide:
Open Photos and find the blurry shot of a form pinned to a fridge, from four days ago.
Open Photoshop, pick that photo under 'Select a photo' and drag Unblur all the way up.
Read the 'Previous marriages' row under Applicant 2: Colm Teague.
Why: The ticked box is 'Never married'.

questions.question:
He lied on a legal form with me sitting right next to him 😤
So that order on hold wasn't sabotage. Bex was trying to stop my money from going out the door.
How much did she manage to save for me?
questions.revealGuide:
Open Notes and read the unlocked note 'misc': it says '🔒 = the certificate no.'
Open Photos and read 'Certificate No. 40718' on the certified marriage copy.
Unlock the note 'What I know' with 40718 and scroll to the money section.
Why: The line reads 'Total I could save for her: $9,200', the catering balance she got put on hold.

questions.question:
In my head I accused her of the worst thing a friend can do.
She's known all of this, and she sat across from me last night smiling and folding place cards.
She must have a plan. Bex always has a plan.
When was she going to tell me?
questions.revealGuide:
Open Calendar and look past today's fitting.
Skip the wedding events and open the 6:00 PM entry 'L. — my place. Bring the folder.'
Read its note: 'Tell her. Everything.'
Why: The event is set for August 7, the day after the fitting.

questions.question:
That soon 🥲
That's so like her, though. If it had to come out, she'd want me to hear it from him first.
She'd think he owed me that much.
How long did she give him to tell me himself?
questions.hint: Read the most recent part of her Messages.
questions.revealGuide:
Open Messages and open the thread with Colm Teague.
Go to the newest messages; ignore his earlier pleas for 'a week' and 'until after the honeymoon'.
Read what Bex sent yesterday evening.
Why: She wrote '48 hours. That's what you get to tell her yourself.'

questions.question:
And he's used almost all of it saying nothing.
I was ready to cut her out of my life this morning. My best friend.
Bex would never leave me alone in my apartment on what was supposed to be my wedding weekend 😔
Where was she planning to take me that weekend?
questions.revealGuide:
Open Mail, open the menu and go to Drafts.
Open the unsent draft addressed to Lucia, 'Before you say anything'.
Read the second paragraph.
Why: She booked Heron Cottage on Lake Wren for the wedding weekend, to take Lucia away.

textSuccess:
I walked in here this morning sure my best friend was taking my wedding away from me.

She was. Just not the way I thought. She spent a month she couldn't afford, flew halfway across the country, turned down five thousand dollars she badly needed, and never let me see her flinch.

Colm had forty-eight hours and three years. He used neither.

There's a woman in Tulsa who's owed an apology from somebody, and a little boy who's owed a lot more than that. I can't fix it for them. But I know about them now.

I'm going to put her phone back in my bag, zip up this dress one last time, and when Bex comes out of that fitting room I'm going to ask her how far the drive is to the lake. Thank you. ❤️

onboardingContent.text: I'm Lucia. I run a flower shop, and in ten days I'm getting married. I should be glowing. Instead I'm hiding in a bridal boutique bathroom, holding a phone that isn't mine.
Bex and I met freshman year, fighting over the last dryer in the dorm. Thirteen years later she's my maid of honor. She's the one who talked me into opening the shop.
Rebecca Holloway. Bex. She's a paralegal, so she notices everything and says about half of it. Lately she takes calls outside, cancels on me, and vanished for two days with no real explanation.
She's in the fitting room right now, and her phone was in my bag. I have maybe twenty minutes. I'll ask, you look. Please, just tell me I'm being paranoid.

SHUT UP. I'm screaming. Hartwell next?
Hartwell for the tent, then the cake tasting. I made a spreadsheet. Don't laugh.
Never. Send it, I'll make my own copy with colors.
At the flower market. Peonies are insane this year. Do you want 40 photos or 4?

🌸🌸🌸🌸 okay. Also you're giving a speech and you're not allowed to say no
I've been drafting since the day you got engaged. It's on v3 already.

I hate that I missed it. Save me a slice?
I took the whole box home. It's in my fridge. Come get it.
Final dress fitting is August 6 at 9:30, Belle Laurel. Put it in your calendar, you're coming. No excuses.
Already in. With an alarm. And a backup alarm.
Shop was slammed today. Three sympathy arrangements and a quinceañera. My feet are dead 😩
Sit. Eat something that isn't a granola bar. I'm sending good energy and zero advice.
Two years of shop savings in that fund and Colm just tells me the total, I don't even look anymore.
Which is sweet that you trust him. Maybe look once in a while, that's all. It's a lot of money.
I know, I know. Paranoid. He's good with numbers, I'm good with peonies. That's the deal 😂
Can you cover your half of the bachelorette deposit by the end of the week? No stress if not.
Two payments behind on the car.
Payday's soon. I'll get the deposit to you then, I promise.
Bex, forget it, I'll float it. Pay me back whenever ❤️
Thank you. I mean it.
Place card font debate. Script or serif??
Serif. Script is unreadable by candlelight and you know it.
License application DONE!! Sat right next to him while he filled out his half 😭 copy's on my fridge.
Look at you two. Proud of you.
Work trip, out-of-town depo. Back in two days, signal will be trash.
Ugh, now?? Ten days before the wedding?? Okay. Safe travels 😩
Hey, you alive? Seating chart question, call me when you can
Barely. Depo ran long. Talk when I'm back.
You're back?? I have so much to tell you. Table 7 is a disaster.
Back. Sorry for the silence. Table 7 sounds like a Dale-and-his-wife problem.
Thanks for coming by this afternoon. You were so quiet though, everything okay?
Just tired. Depo hangover. Go to bed, bride.
Colm says one of our vendors has us ON HOLD and he won't tell me which, says he's handling it. I didn't do that!! Did you hear anything?
Weird. Let me look into it.
You're the best. I'm trying not to spiral. There's an explanation, right?
Still coming tonight? I'm ordering Rosa's. Place cards won't fold themselves 🍕
Yes. Bringing the good scissors.
I'm wiped, heading home. Love you.
Love you more. Text me when you're home 🌸
Home. Docket is judging me from the couch.
Fitting tomorrow!! Don't be late, I'm bringing coffee ☕

| | |

Flat, shaded in the first mile, and the river is right there the whole way. It is one of the few places in town where you can hold an easy conversational pace without a single hill.

- **Easy 5K:** Trailhead to the pedestrian bridge and back

**North Carolina Judicial Branch — Local Rules and Civil Calendar**

## Civil session calendar

Civil sessions are published by term. Counsel should confirm the presiding judge and courtroom assignment with the Trial Court Administrator no later than the Thursday before the session begins.

## Filing reminders

1. **E-filing is mandatory** for attorneys in all civil matters unless an exception has been granted.
2. Filings made after 5:00 PM are deemed filed the next business day.
3. Proposed orders must be submitted in editable format.
4. Courtesy copies are not required unless directed by the court.

## Calendar requests

Requests to place a matter on the trial calendar must be made in writing to the Trial Court Administrator and served on all parties. Include:

- Case caption and file number
- Estimated length of trial
- Whether a jury has been demanded
- Any scheduling conflicts for counsel or key witnesses

## Mediated settlement conferences

Parties must complete a mediated settlement conference before trial in most civil actions. The mediator's report is due within 10 days of the conference.

Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM

safariTabs.content:
# 10-Minute Hip Opening Sequence for Desk Workers
**Yoga Flow Daily**

---

Sitting for eight hours shortens the hip flexors and tightens everything that wraps around the pelvis. This short sequence is designed to undo some of that between your last meeting and dinner.

## The sequence

1. **Child's pose** — 1 minute. Knees wide, forehead down, breathe into your lower back.
2. **Low lunge** — 1 minute per side. Sink the hips forward and keep the back knee padded.
3. **Lizard pose** — 1 minute per side. Forearms on a block if the floor feels far away.
4. **Pigeon pose** — 90 seconds per side. Fold forward only as far as feels comfortable.
5. **Supine figure four** — 1 minute per side. Great if pigeon bothers your knees.
6. **Happy baby** — 1 minute. Rock gently side to side.
7. **Legs up the wall** — 2 minutes to finish.

## Tips

- Never push into sharp pain. A deep stretch should feel like a release, not a pinch.
- Props are not cheating: blocks, bolsters, and folded blankets are your friends.
- If you're short on time, do steps 2, 4, and 7 only.

safariTabs.content:
# How to Plan a Bachelorette Weekend on a Budget (and Split Costs Fairly)
**ShareSplit Guide — Group trips without the awkward money talk**

---

Everyone wants to celebrate the bride. Not everyone wants to put $600 on a credit card to do it. Here's how to keep the weekend fun and the group friendly.

## 1. Set a ceiling before you pick a place

Ask the group privately what they're comfortable spending. Plan to the lowest number, not the average.

## 2. Pick a rental over a hotel

A house for six splits much cheaper than three hotel rooms, and you get a kitchen for group breakfasts.

## 3. Cook one night, go out one night

A potluck-style dinner at the house saves real money and usually becomes the best part of the weekend.

## 4. Decide who covers the bride

The usual approach is to split the bride's share evenly among everyone else. Say so up front.

## 5. Use one payment app and a shared note

- One person fronts the deposit
- Everyone pays back within a week
- Keep a running list of who has paid what

## 6. Keep the decor simple

A sash, a banner, and a good playlist go further than a hundred dollars of themed props.

---
